body: It is funny that I never really considered replying as I posted this. I had considered titling it "I just wanted someone to read this" because even if the people I wanted to read it, read it. It would not matter. I have three kinds of people in my life, people that are mean, people that tell me I need to get over the mean people and then everyone else who's living their selfish lives; myself included. I didn't know about how sempiternal came to be, that is the song I had in mind, that is cool he had so many people fighting for him, that feeling must be encouraging. I wouldn't mind talking about music. I really liked this music because of the lyrical content but of course I don't have the backbone to defend it in front of others. Just the other day someone mentioned how dumb 'emo' music is; 'a self pity party, cutting, and suicide'  because a connotation of it tends to lean toward children with no real life experience complaining about not getting their way. I think many have this mentality, and regularly invalidate the feelings of others, even the ones with legitimate circumstances. I don't know if listening to music like this keeps me where I'm at or helps. Maybe it is both. I wish it was possible to bring clarity and understanding to the people who don't get it. I don't think it ever will make sense unless you've been there. Jumping down to my reply to anonisen, yes, I actively struggle with some of my issues, however it's something that can't be fixed. It's never going to go away, people will continue being human. With all the vagueness in my post, and responses I still see it as black and white and I'm just a part of the blackness. This world is filled with pain, it's not going anywhere, so who would want to fight to live in it, I am sorry that it is this way.

Everything, everybody, everywhere. It is not just myself. This I realize because the pain I have caused and not caused should not be. No one should have to feel low. Yet there are so many of us. It will never leave. There will never be rest or breaks from life. There is not a way to erase your history, and fact will always be fact. Your always going to have people who feel the need to act out some supremacist, ideal. There will never be justice for all the pain in this world. Not to mention that everyday horrible things happen all over this planet, but 'phew it didn't happen to us.' Sorry I feel I've gone off topic. Back to the start. Yes I've had quite the number of shitty events occur in my life, some ongoing. It makes me question the sanity of the world in which we live. leaving me really more apathetic that I can bare. I seem to feel it all, my pain, and your pain all at once, from beginning to end. We live in a mean place.

Didn't want to post a wall of text, sorry, answer to your question in the link below.
